text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I see. I understand that this is not a 
game in violation of school regulations. 
Thank you for taking the time to come 
here, Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Madam President. Do you 
really think an apology is all it takes?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You stole my time. And over a mistake, no 
less.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Then giving up some of your time too is 
only fair, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that a threat?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, it's merely a suggestion. So 
with that said... how about a little 
match?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I never dreamed that the renowned 
"Emperor" would be a cruel tyrant who 
simply steals and runs away, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Well, well. You've completely cut 
off my escape route, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I accept your challenge. What 
event shall it be?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Chess it is. You can take White, 
President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Is this bravery, or sheer 
recklessness? To hand over the 
advantageous first move even knowing this 
is a game I excel at.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha, I just want to enjoy myself. Savoring 
our showdown to the absolute fullest... 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now, let the game begin...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: How about... this!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(She sacrificed a pawn... The King's 
Gambit?!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(A chaotic brawl is inevitable... No, this 
is already—!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Confusion! Chaos! Heh heh, that's how it's 
gotta be...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Fascinating!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Man, as expected of the President. That 
was quite entertaining."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you've got any boring moments next 
time, let's 'steal' each other's time 
again."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I won, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Still, what a game! My fingertips still 
feel like they're burning...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Kh... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I thank you, Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My mind feels unusually sharp and clear—!
